items.text: Patriots will likely activate WR AJ Brown off IR to play vs Jets Sunday after high-ankle sprain; practiced limited this week.
items.why: Returned to practice after IR stint; sources confirm anticipated return.
items.implication: Must-start WR2/flex upside in return vs Jets; monitor snap share on activation.
items.opportunity: Primary target for Drake Maye; role expansion upon return.

items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR; remains sidelined indefinitely with superficial blood clot. First game without him; Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; sources confirm no IR plans while gathering info.
items.implication: Sit Hurts; McKee gets start with healthy top-4 pass-catchers (Smith/Goedert/Wicks).
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher volume stable; thin RB behind Pierce.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday vs Panthers.
items.implication: Sit Barkley; PHI RB room thin with Shipley also OUT.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining backs including 4th-string Dameon Pierce per Levitan.

items.text: Ravens ruled out QB Lamar Jackson for Sunday at Cleveland due to ankle; missed all practice this week. Tyler Huntley likely starts again.
items.why: Ankle sprain; DNP all week, second straight miss.
items.implication: Sit Lamar; Huntley fills in with prior success in spot starts.
items.opportunity: Ravens skill players still viable but QB downgrade.

items.text: Assuming AJ Brown active for Patriots he'll be active for me; starting him as WR2 wherever rostered. Also notes Saquon not looking good.
items.why: Pelissero/Rapoport reports of activation/play; personal roster need.
items.implication: Start Brown if active; confirm Saquon OUT.

items.text: On ETR Q list: unclear on AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday add Q. Probables: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. PIT thin at WR (expect 2-WR sets heavy Metcalf). PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks) despite 4th-string RB Pierce.
items.why: Practice trends and designations; PIT WR absences (Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek); PHI depth chart.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean play on Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle/Caleb; PHI pass catchers viable with McKee.
items.opportunity: Metcalf heavy usage in 2-WR; PHI top pass-catchers full routes; Warren Q risk.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT for Jets (with AD Mitchell); per ETR Sunday injuries roundup.
items.why: Quad injury; official ETR compilation from reports.
items.implication: Sit Hall; Jets RB committee shifts.

items.text: David Montgomery listed OUT for Texans (groin) in ETR injuries; confirmed across reports.
items.implication: Sit Montgomery; HOU RB volume to others.

items.text: Rashee Rice listed OUT for Chiefs (with Tyquan Thornton) in ETR Sunday injuries.
items.implication: Sit Rice; KC WR targets redistribute (Worthy etc).
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining KC pass-catchers.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation for Sunday at KC; cleared/IN per ETR.
items.why: No designation after foot issue; full clear.
items.implication: Start McConkey with confidence; full role expected.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday vs Rams.
items.implication: Sit Love; ARI backfield opportunity opens.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining ARI RBs.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders secondary buffet for pass catchers. All-in top-5 WR play.
items.why: Elite matchup vs WSH defense nightmare for WRs; usage bankable.
items.opportunity: High target/route share in favorable spot.

items.text: LOVE Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ). Soft matchups + volume/roles (Kyren elite usage, Javonte goal-line).
items.why: WSH defense soft for Kittle/Evans group; London usage; RBs vs leaky run Ds with volume.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA WR28), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT WR34), Kyle Pitts (vs CHI TE18), J.K. Dobbins (vs SEA RB27), Bo Nix (vs SEA QB23), Justin Herbert (@KC QB25). Ugly matchups, shaky QB/roles, low totals.
items.why: Tough pass/run Ds (SEA elite), limited recent feeding, lowest team totals.
